text: Foundation slice complete: motionJVM now depends on bidsJVM only; JVM adapters cover lightweight NIfTI/sidecar IO, BIDS raw/preproc scan descriptors with TR and SliceTiming-derived AcquisitionTiming, and motion TSV/matrix CSV/summary CSV report bundle rendering/writing. Added MotionIoSuite coverage for NIfTI run/mask reads, BIDS sidecar discovery, and report bundle shape. Verified motionJVM/test (81 tests), motionJS/test (77 tests), git diff --check, and trailing-whitespace scan. Remaining: CLI estimate/apply/run/report commands, broader real-data adapter coverage, compressed NIfTI write policy, and benchmark handoff.
